name: qa-orchestrator
description: QA for one or more Jira issues through agents: qa-orchestrator asks which skill to run (qa-pipeline, jira-qa-cli, jira-qa-parallel-cli, jira-qa-retest-cli, plus qa-design-check), applies the ai-qa-tested label (configurable) and hands each step to a fresh qa-skill-runner; qa-artifact-reviewer checks the qa-pipeline gates. Hooks enforce the rules: the label before the runner, the runner never writes to Jira, a comment whose footer disagrees with its text is not posted. Installs jira-qa, qa-pipeline and qa-design-check as dependencies. Needs only node.
